mapper.select: SELECT SHIFT_DATE,LOT_ID,MAINPD_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,WAFER_QTY,PRODSPEC_ID,STB_TIME,OPE_NO,CASSETE_ID,PRODG1 ,TECH,REQUEST_DAY,TARGET_OPE,PURPOSE,LOT_PRIORITY,REMAIN_STEP,REMAIN_LAYER,REMAIN_DAY,NEED_CT,DUR,TD_TR ,F_COMMENT,TARGET_TR,DIFF,EQP_G,HOLD_COMMENT,STAY_TIME,FAB,LOCATION,MODULE ,CLIP_WEEK,DTH_TARGET_TR,STD_STAY_TIME,STAY_TIME_DIFF,TOP_FLAG,FCST_DAY FROM( SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD')SHIFT_DATE,A.LOT_ID,MAINPD_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,WAFER_QTY ,PRODSPEC_ID,STB_TIME,OPE_NO,CASSETE_ID ,PRODG1,TECH,REQUEST_DAY,TARGET_OPE,A.PURPOSE,TO_NUMBER(LOT_PRIORITY)LOT_PRIORITY ,REMAIN_STEP,REMAIN_LAYER,REMAIN_DAY,NEED_CT,DUR,STAY_TIME,FAB,LOCATION,TD_TR,F_COMMENT,TARGET_TR,DIFF,EQP_G,HOLD_COMMENT,MODULE ,CLIP_WEEK,DTH_TARGET_TR ,STD_STAY_TIME,STAY_TIME_DIFF,TOP_FLAG,B.FCST_DAY FROM( SELECT LOT_ID,PURPOSE,TOP_FLAG,FUNCTION_NAME FROM A1MFG.PULLIN_LOT_UPLOAD WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = #{functionName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )A LEFT JOIN A1MFG.PULLIN_LOT_SUMMARY B ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID AND A.FUNCTION_NAME = B.FUNCTION_NAME WHERE TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD') = nvl(#{shiftDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD')) UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SHIFT_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')-1,'YYYYMMDD')SHIFT_DATE,LOT_ID,MAINPD_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,WAFER_QTY ,PRODSPEC_ID,STB_TIME,OPE_NO,CASSETE_ID ,PRODG1,TECH,REQUEST_DAY,TARGET_OPE,PURPOSE,LOT_PRIORITY ,REMAIN_STEP,REMAIN_LAYER,REMAIN_DAY,NEED_CT,DUR,STAY_TIME,FAB,LOCATION,TD_TR,F_COMMENT,TARGET_TR,DIFF,EQP_G,HOLD_COMMENT,MODULE ,CLIP_WEEK,TD_TR DTH_TARGET_TR ,STD_STAY_TIME,STAY_TIME_DIFF,'N' TOP_FLAG , FCST_DAY FROM A1MFG.PULLIN_LOT_SUMMARY_HS WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = #{functionName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SHIFT_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')-1,'YYYYMMDD')=nvl(#{shiftDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD')) )ORDER BY DECODE(TOP_FLAG,'Y',1,'N',2),LOT_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO A1MFG.PULLIN_LOT_SUMMARY(FUNCTION_NAME,LOT_ID,MAINPD_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,WAFER_QTY,PRODSPEC_ID,STB_TIME,OPE_NO,CASSETE_ID,PRODG1,TECH,REQUEST_DAY,TARGET_OPE,PURPOSE,LOT_PRIORITY,FCST_DAY,REMAIN_STEP,REMAIN_LAYER,REMAIN_DAY,NEED_CT,DUR,TD_TR,F_COMMENT,TARGET_TR,DIFF,EQP_G,HOLD_COMMENT,STAY_TIME,STD_STAY_TIME,STAY_TIME_DIFF,FAB,LOCATION,MODULE,CLIP_WEEK,DTH_TARGET_TR) WITH BASE_LOT_DETAIL AS( SELECT A.FUNCTION_NAME,A.LOT_ID,B.MAINPD_ID,B.LOT_PROC_STATE,B.WAFER_QTY,B.PRODSPEC_ID,B.STB_TIME,B.OPE_NO,B.LAST_CLAIM_TIME,B.CASSETE_ID ,B.FAB,B.LOCATION,B.LAST_OPE_COMP_TIME FROM( SELECT DISTINCT LOT_ID,PURPOSE,FUNCTION_NAME FROM A1MFG.PULLIN_LOT_UPLOAD WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = #{source,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )A LEFT JOIN( SELECT FAB,LOCATION,LAST_OPE_COMP_TIME, LOT_ID,MAINPD_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,WAFER_QTY,PRODSPEC_ID,STB_TIME,OPE_NO,LAST_CLAIM_TIME,CASSETE_ID FROM A3MFGYW1.V_LOT_SUMMARY_ALL@TO_A3MFG )B ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID ) ,DYB_LOT_LIST AS( SELECT FUNCTION_NAME,LOT_ID,MAINPD_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,WAFER_QTY,PRODSPEC_ID,STB_TIME,OPE_NO,LAST_CLAIM_TIME,CASSETE_ID,LAST_OPE_COMP_TIME ,FAB,LOCATION FROM BASE_LOT_DETAIL WHERE MAINPD_ID LIKE 'YY%' OR MAINPD_ID LIKE 'YX%' OR MAINPD_ID LIKE 'B%' OR MAINPD_ID LIKE 'DYB%' ),DYB_LOT_LAST_OPENO AS( SELECT FUNCTION_NAME, LOT_ID,MAINPD_ID,OPE_NO,LOT_PROC_STATE,WAFER_QTY,PRODSPEC_ID,STB_TIME,LAST_MAIN_OPENO,LAST_CLAIM_TIME,CASSETE_ID,CLAIM_TIME ,LAST_OPE_COMP_TIME,FAB,LOCATION FROM( SELECT FUNCTION_NAME, LOT_ID,MAINPD_ID,OPE_NO,LOT_PROC_STATE,WAFER_QTY,PRODSPEC_ID,STB_TIME,LAST_MAIN_OPENO,LAST_CLAIM_TIME,CASSETE_ID,CLAIM_TIME,LAST_OPE_COMP_TIME ,FAB,LOCATION ,ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY LOT_ID,FUNCTION_NAME ORDER BY CLAIM_TIME DESC)RN FROM( SELECT A.FUNCTION_NAME, A.LOT_ID,A.MAINPD_ID,A.OPE_NO,A.LOT_PROC_STATE,A.WAFER_QTY,A.PRODSPEC_ID,A.STB_TIME,NVL(B.OPE_NO,A.OPE_NO)LAST_MAIN_OPENO ,A.LAST_CLAIM_TIME,A.CASSETE_ID,B.CLAIM_TIME,A.LAST_OPE_COMP_TIME,A.FAB,A.LOCATION FROM DYB_LOT_LIST A LEFT JOIN ODS.FHOPEHS B ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID WHERE (B.OPE_CATEGORY = 'Branch' OR B.OPE_CATEGORY = 'Rework') AND B.MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'YY%' AND B.MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'YX%' AND B.MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'DYB%' AND B.MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'B%' UNION ALL SELECT A.FUNCTION_NAME, A.LOT_ID,A.MAINPD_ID,A.OPE_NO,A.LOT_PROC_STATE,A.WAFER_QTY,A.PRODSPEC_ID,A.STB_TIME,NVL(B.OPE_NO,A.OPE_NO)LAST_MAIN_OPENO ,A.LAST_CLAIM_TIME,A.CASSETE_ID,B.CLAIM_TIME,A.LAST_OPE_COMP_TIME,A.FAB,A.LOCATION FROM DYB_LOT_LIST A LEFT JOIN PWEB.FHOPEHS_A3 B ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID WHERE (B.OPE_CATEGORY = 'Branch' OR B.OPE_CATEGORY = 'Rework') AND B.MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'YY%' AND B.MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'YX%' AND B.MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'DYB%' AND B.MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'B%' ))WHERE RN=1 ) ,BASE_LOT_INFO AS( SELECT FUNCTION_NAME,LOT_ID,MAINPD_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,WAFER_QTY,PRODSPEC_ID,STB_TIME,OPE_NO,LAST_CLAIM_TIME,CASSETE_ID,OPE_NO LAST_MAIN_OPENO ,LAST_OPE_COMP_TIME,FAB,LOCATION FROM BASE_LOT_DETAIL A WHERE MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'YY%' AND MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'YX%' AND MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'B%' AND MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'DYB%' UNION ALL SELECT FUNCTION_NAME,LOT_ID,MAINPD_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,WAFER_QTY,PRODSPEC_ID,STB_TIME,OPE_NO,LAST_CLAIM_TIME,CASSETE_ID,LAST_MAIN_OPENO ,LAST_OPE_COMP_TIME,FAB,LOCATION FROM DYB_LOT_LAST_OPENO B ) ,DTH_TR_INFO AS( SELECT FUNCTION_NAME, LOT_ID,SUM(TR_FLAG)TD_TR ,LISTAGG(OPE_FLAG,' ')WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY CLAIM_TIME)F_COMMENT FROM( SELECT C.FUNCTION_NAME, C.LOT_ID,C.OPE_NO,C.ACT_CT,D.STD_CT,CLAIM_TIME ,CASE WHEN C.MAINPD_ID LIKE 'YY%' OR C.MAINPD_ID LIKE 'YX%' OR C.MAINPD_ID LIKE 'DYB%' OR C.MAINPD_ID LIKE 'B%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END TR_FLAG ,CASE WHEN (C.MAINPD_ID LIKE 'YY%' OR C.MAINPD_ID LIKE 'YX%' OR C.MAINPD_ID LIKE 'DYB%' OR C.MAINPD_ID LIKE 'B%') AND ROUND(ACT_CT,1) > 0 THEN C.OPE_NO || '('||TO_CHAR(C.ACT_CT-0,'FM999990.0') || ')' WHEN (C.MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'YY%' AND C.MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'YX%' AND C.MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'DYB%' AND C.MAINPD_ID NOT LIKE 'B%') AND ROUND(ACT_CT-NVL(STD_CT,0),1)>0 THEN C.OPE_NO || '('||TO_CHAR(C.ACT_CT-NVL(D.STD_CT,0),'FM999990.0') || ')' END OPE_FLAG FROM( SELECT B.FUNCTION_NAME,A.LOT_ID,OPE_NO,CLAIM_TIME,MAINPD_ID,PREV_OP_COMP_TIME,(CLAIM_TIME-PREV_OP_COMP_TIME)*24 ACT_CT FROM ( SELECT LOT_ID,OPE_NO,MAINPD_ID,COMPLETE_TIME CLAIM_TIME,PREV_OP_COMP_TIME FROM A3MFGYW1.V_MOVE_SUMMARY@TO_A3MFG WHERE MOVE_FLAG =1 AND SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD') AND PW_FLAG =1 )A JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT LOT_ID,FUNCTION_NAME FROM BASE_LOT_DETAIL )B ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID )C LEFT JOIN A1MFG.PULLIN_LOT_FLOW_CT D ON C.LOT_ID = D.LOT_ID AND C.OPE_NO = D.OPER_NO AND C.FUNCTION_NAME = D.FUNCTION_NAME )GROUP BY LOT_ID,FUNCTION_NAME ) ,HOLD_COMMENT_INFO AS( SELECT LOT_ID,HOLD_COMMENT FROM( SELECT LOT_ID,HOLD_COMMENT,ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY LOT_ID ORDER BY CLAIM_TIME)RN FROM( SELECT LOT_ID,HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO HOLD_COMMENT,CLAIM_TIME FROM ODS.HOLD_DETAIL_HISTORY A WHERE RELEASE_TIME IS NULL AND HOLD_USER_ID <>'CROSSWD' AND HOLD_TYPE <>'BankHold'AND HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM( SELECT DISTINCT LOT_ID FROM BASE_LOT_DETAIL WHERE LOT_PROC_STATE = 'OnHold' )B WHERE A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID ) UNION ALL SELECT LOT_ID,HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO HOLD_COMMENT,CLAIM_TIME FROM PWEB.ODS_HOLD_DETAIL_HISTORY_A3 A WHERE RELEASE_TIME IS NULL AND HOLD_USER_ID <>'CROSSWD' AND HOLD_TYPE <>'BankHold'AND HOLD_CLAIM_MEMO IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM( SELECT DISTINCT LOT_ID FROM BASE_LOT_DETAIL WHERE LOT_PROC_STATE = 'OnHold' )B WHERE A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID )))WHERE RN =1 ) ,TARGET_TR_INFO AS( SELECT FUNCTION_NAME,LOT_ID,COUNT(1)TARGET_TR,SUM(CASE WHEN CT_FORECAST <= (SYSDATE- (TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24)+7.5/24))*24 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)DTH_TARGET_TR FROM A1MFG.PULLIN_LOT_FLOW_CT WHERE CT_FORECAST <= 24 GROUP BY LOT_ID,FUNCTION_NAME ) ,BASE_INFO AS( SELECT A.*,B.PRODG1,C.MFG_TECH TECH ,CASE WHEN A.MAINPD_ID LIKE 'YY%' OR A.MAINPD_ID LIKE 'YX%' OR A.MAINPD_ID LIKE 'B%' OR A.MAINPD_ID LIKE 'DYB%' THEN B.FLOW_ID ELSE A.MAINPD_ID END FLOW_ID ,D.REQUEST_DAY ,D.TARGET_OPE ,D.PURPOSE,E.LOT_PRIORITY,E.FCST_DAY ,NVL(H.OPE_SEQ_MAX,D.OPER_SEQ) - F.OPER_SEQ REMAIN_STEP , F.LAYER_COUNT REMAIN_LAYER ,FLOOR((TO_DATE(REQUEST_DAY,'YYYYMMDD')+1+7.5/24 -SYSDATE)*10)/10 REMAIN_DAY ,CASE WHEN (CEIL(F.LAYER_COUNT*10)/10) >0 THEN FLOOR((FLOOR((TO_DATE(REQUEST_DAY,'YYYYMMDD')+1+7.5/24 -SYSDATE)*10)/10)/(CEIL(F.LAYER_COUNT*10)/10)*10)/10 END NEED_CT ,ROUND((SYSDATE-LAST_CLAIM_TIME)*24,1)DUR ,CASE WHEN A.LOT_PROC_STATE = 'Processing' THEN ROUND((A.LAST_CLAIM_TIME-A.LAST_OPE_COMP_TIME)*24,1) ELSE ROUND((SYSDATE-A.LAST_OPE_COMP_TIME)*24,1) END STAY_TIME ,ROUND(NVL((G.STD_CT - G.TM),0),1) STD_STAY_TIME FROM BASE_LOT_INFO A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT 'N1A1'FAB, PRODSPEC_ID,PRODG1,FLOW_ID FROM ODS.WP_PRODUCT UNION ALL SELECT 'N1A3'FAB, PRODSPEC_ID,PRODG1,FLOW_ID FROM PWEB.WP_PRODUCT_A3 ) B ON A.PRODSPEC_ID =B.PRODSPEC_ID AND A.FAB = B.FAB LEFT JOIN A1MFG.PRODUCT_TECH_INFO C ON B.PRODG1 = C.PRODG1 LEFT JOIN A1MFG.PULLIN_LOT_UPLOAD D ON A.LOT_ID = D.LOT_ID AND A.FUNCTION_NAME = D.FUNCTION_NAME LEFT JOIN PWEB.A3_LOT_PRIORITY E ON A.LOT_ID = E.LOT_ID LEFT JOIN A1MFG.PULLIN_LOT_FLOW_CT F ON A.LOT_ID = F.LOT_ID AND A.LAST_MAIN_OPENO = F.OPER_NO AND A.FUNCTION_NAME = F.FUNCTION_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT LOT_ID,FUNCTION_NAME,MAX(OPER_SEQ)OPE_SEQ_MAX FROM A1MFG.PULLIN_LOT_FLOW_CT GROUP BY LOT_ID,FUNCTION_NAME )H ON A.LOT_ID = H.LOT_ID AND A.FUNCTION_NAME = H.FUNCTION_NAME LEFT JOIN A1MFG.PULLIN_LOT_FLOW_CT G ON A.LOT_ID = G.LOT_ID AND A.OPE_NO = G.OPER_NO AND A.FUNCTION_NAME = G.FUNCTION_NAME ) SELECT FUNCTION_NAME,LOT_ID,MAINPD_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,WAFER_QTY,PRODSPEC_ID,STB_TIME,OPE_NO,CASSETE_ID,PRODG1 ,TECH,REQUEST_DAY,TARGET_OPE,PURPOSE,LOT_PRIORITY,FCST_DAY,REMAIN_STEP,REMAIN_LAYER,REMAIN_DAY,NEED_CT,DUR,TD_TR ,F_COMMENT,TARGET_TR,DIFF,EQP_G,HOLD_COMMENT,STAY_TIME,STD_STAY_TIME, ROUND(STAY_TIME - STD_STAY_TIME,1) STAY_TIME_DIFF ,FAB,LOCATION,MODULE ,CLIP_WEEK,DTH_TARGET_TR FROM( SELECT FUNCTION_NAME, LOT_ID,MAINPD_ID,LOT_PROC_STATE,WAFER_QTY ,PRODSPEC_ID,STB_TIME,OPE_NO,CASSETE_ID ,PRODG1,TECH,REQUEST_DAY,TARGET_OPE,PURPOSE,TO_NUMBER(LOT_PRIORITY)LOT_PRIORITY,FCST_DAY ,REMAIN_STEP,REMAIN_LAYER,REMAIN_DAY,NEED_CT,DUR,STAY_TIME,STD_STAY_TIME,FAB,LOCATION,TD_TR,F_COMMENT,TARGET_TR,DIFF,EQP_G,HOLD_COMMENT,MODULE ,CLIP_WEEK,DTH_TARGET_TR FROM( SELECT A.*,NVL(B.TD_TR,0)TD_TR,B.F_COMMENT,C.TARGET_TR, NVL(B.TD_TR,0) - C.DTH_TARGET_TR DIFF ,CASE WHEN SUBSTR(A.OPE_NO,1,6) IN('ST.TTS','ST.801') THEN 'WAT_Tester' WHEN SUBSTR(A.OPE_NO,1,3) = 'ST.' THEN 'OQC_Tester' ELSE D.EQP_G END EQP_G ,E.HOLD_COMMENT ,CASE WHEN FAB = 'N1A1' THEN A1MFG.GET_MODULE_QTIME_NEW(A.MAINPD_ID,A.OPE_NO) WHEN FAB = 'N1A3' THEN REPLACE(A3MFGYW1.GET_MODULE_NORMAL@TO_A3MFG(A.MAINPD_ID,A.OPE_NO),'Measure','METRO') END MODULE ,F.WEEK_SEQ CLIP_WEEK,C.DTH_TARGET_TR FROM BASE_INFO A LEFT JOIN DTH_TR_INFO B ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID AND A.FUNCTION_NAME = B.FUNCTION_NAME LEFT JOIN TARGET_TR_INFO C ON A.LOT_ID = C.LOT_ID AND A.FUNCTION_NAME = C.FUNCTION_NAME LEFT JOIN PWEB.OPE_NO_INLINE_FLOW_PSTD D ON A.PRODSPEC_ID = D.PRODSPEC_ID AND A.OPE_NO = D.OPE_NO LEFT JOIN HOLD_COMMENT_INFO E ON A.LOT_ID = E.LOT_ID LEFT JOIN A1MFG.A3_CLIP_CALENDAR F ON A.REQUEST_DAY= F.SHIFT_DATE ) )
mapper.select: SELECT C.MODULE,C.LABEL,C.NAME ,ROUND(PRE3M)PRE3M ,ROUND(PRE2M)PRE2M ,ROUND(PRE1M)PRE1M ,ROUND(PRE4WEEK)PRE4WEEK ,ROUND(PRE3WEEK)PRE3WEEK ,ROUND(PRE2WEEK)PRE2WEEK ,ROUND(PRE1WEEK)PRE1WEEK ,ROUND(PRE7D)PRE7D ,ROUND(PRE6D)PRE6D ,ROUND(PRE5D)PRE5D ,ROUND(PRE4D)PRE4D ,ROUND(PRE3D)PRE3D ,ROUND(PRE2D)PRE2D ,ROUND(PRE1D)PRE1D ,ROUND(CUR_DAY)CUR_DAY FROM( SELECT A.MODULE,B.NAME,B.LABEL,B.RANK_,B.FAB FROM( SELECT 'PHOTO' MODULE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'ETCH' MODULE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'TF' MODULE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'DIFF' MODULE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'WET' MODULE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'CMP' MODULE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'METRO' MODULE FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 'TTL' MODULE FROM DUAL )A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT KEY1 NAME,KEY2 LABEL ,KEY4 RANK_,KEY3 FAB FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'PULLINWEB_TABNAME' AND KEY5 ='Y' AND KEY3 =#{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )B ON 1=1 )C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FAB,FUNCTION_NAME,MODULE ,AVG(PRE3M)PRE3M ,AVG(PRE2M)PRE2M ,AVG(PRE1M)PRE1M ,AVG(PRE4WEEK)PRE4WEEK ,AVG(PRE3WEEK)PRE3WEEK ,AVG(PRE2WEEK)PRE2WEEK ,AVG(PRE1WEEK)PRE1WEEK ,AVG(PRE7D)PRE7D ,AVG(PRE6D)PRE6D ,AVG(PRE5D)PRE5D ,AVG(PRE4D)PRE4D ,AVG(PRE3D)PRE3D ,AVG(PRE2D)PRE2D ,AVG(PRE1D)PRE1D ,AVG(CUR_DAY)CUR_DAY FROM( SELECT A.*,B.SHIFT_MONTH,B.WEEK_SEQ ,CASE WHEN B.SHIFT_MONTH = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24),-3),'YYYYMM') THEN DELAY_COUNT END PRE3M ,CASE WHEN B.SHIFT_MONTH = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24),-2),'YYYYMM') THEN DELAY_COUNT END PRE2M ,CASE WHEN B.SHIFT_MONTH = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24),-1),'YYYYMM') THEN DELAY_COUNT END PRE1M ,CASE WHEN B.WEEK_SEQ = 'W'||TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'IW')-22,'YYIW') THEN DELAY_COUNT END PRE4WEEK ,CASE WHEN B.WEEK_SEQ = 'W'||TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'IW')-15,'YYIW') THEN DELAY_COUNT END PRE3WEEK ,CASE WHEN B.WEEK_SEQ = 'W'||TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'IW')-8,'YYIW') THEN DELAY_COUNT END PRE2WEEK ,CASE WHEN B.WEEK_SEQ = 'W'||TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'IW')-1,'YYIW') THEN DELAY_COUNT END PRE1WEEK ,CASE WHEN A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24)-7,'YYYYMMDD') THEN DELAY_COUNT END PRE7D ,CASE WHEN A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24)-6,'YYYYMMDD') THEN DELAY_COUNT END PRE6D ,CASE WHEN A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24)-5,'YYYYMMDD') THEN DELAY_COUNT END PRE5D ,CASE WHEN A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24)-4,'YYYYMMDD') THEN DELAY_COUNT END PRE4D ,CASE WHEN A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24)-3,'YYYYMMDD') THEN DELAY_COUNT END PRE3D ,CASE WHEN A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24)-2,'YYYYMMDD') THEN DELAY_COUNT END PRE2D ,CASE WHEN A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24)-1,'YYYYMMDD') THEN DELAY_COUNT END PRE1D ,CASE WHEN A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE-7.5/24),'YYYYMMDD') THEN DELAY_COUNT END CUR_DAY FROM( SELECT SHIFT_DATE,FAB,FUNCTION_NAME,MODULE,DELAY_COUNT FROM A1MFG.PULLIN_LOT_DELAY_SUMMARY )A LEFT JOIN A1MFG.A3_CLIP_CALENDAR B ON A.SHIFT_DATE = B.SHIFT_DATE )GROUP BY FAB,FUNCTION_NAME,MODULE )D ON C.NAME =D.FUNCTION_NAME AND C.FAB = D.FAB AND C.MODULE = D.MODULE ORDER BY DECODE(C.MODULE,'PHOTO',1,'ETCH',2,'TF',3,'DIFF',4,'WET',5,'CMP',6,'METRO',7,8),C.RANK_
SELECT KEY1 name ,KEY2 label FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'PULLINWEB_TABNAME' AND KEY5 = 'Y' AND KEY3 = #{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY KEY4 , UPDATE_TIME

SELECT FUNCTION_NAME ,KEY1 NAME ,KEY2 LABEL ,KEY3 FAB ,KEY4 RANK_ ,KEY5 ACTIVE ,UPDATE_TIME ,UPDATE_USER FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'PULLINWEB_TABNAME' AND KEY3 = #{fab,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY DECODE(KEY5,'Y',1,2), KEY4 , UPDATE_TIME

SELECT A.LOCATION,A.FAB,A.LOT_ID,A.MAINPD_ID,A.OPE_NO,A.STAY_TIME,A.CT,A.PREV_OP_COMP_TIME ,A.PROCESS_START_TIME,A.OP_COMPLETE_TIME,A.OPE_CATEGORY,A.STD_CT,A.STD_STAY_TIME ,B.F_COMMENT FROM A1MFG.PULLIN_LOT_DELAY_MOVE_DETAIL A LEFT JOIN( SELECT FUNCTION_NAME,KEY1 LOT_ID,KEY2 OPE_NO,KEY3 PREV_OP_COMPLETE_TIME,F_COMMENT FROM PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME = 'PULLINWEBDELAYCOMMENT' )B ON A.LOT_ID = B.LOT_ID AND A.OPE_NO = B.OPE_NO AND TO_CHAR(A.PREV_OP_COMP_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') = B.PREV_OP_COMPLETE_TIME WHERE
A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24,'YYYYMMDD')
A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-1,'YYYYMMDD')
A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-2,'YYYYMMDD')
A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-3,'YYYYMMDD')
A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-4,'YYYYMMDD')
A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-5,'YYYYMMDD')
A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-6,'YYYYMMDD')
A.SHIFT_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE-7.5/24-7,'YYYYMMDD')
AND A.FUNCTION_NAME = #{functionName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND A.MODULE = #{module,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
ORDER BY PREV_OP_COMP_TIME ,OP_COMPLETE_TIME,LOT_ID

MERGE INTO PWEB.COMMENT_SUMMARY A USING( SELECT 'PULLINWEBDELAYCOMMENT' FUNCTION_NAME ,#{data.LOT_ID,jdbcType=VARCHAR} KEY1 ,#{data.OPE_NO,jdbcType=VARCHAR}KEY2 ,#{data.PREV_OP_COMPLETE_TIME,jdbcType=VARCHAR} KEY3 ,#{data.F_COMMENT,jdbcType=VARCHAR}F_COMMENT ,#{data.UPDATE_USER,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER ,SYSDATE UPDATE_TIME FROM DUAL ) B ON( A.FUNCTION_NAME = B.FUNCTION_NAME AND A.KEY1 =B.KEY1 AND A.KEY2 = B.KEY2 AND A.KEY3 = B.KEY3 ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET A.F_COMMENT=B.F_COMMENT,A.UPDATE_USER=B.UPDATE_USER,A.UPDATE_TIME = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (FUNCTION_NAME,KEY1,KEY2,KEY3,F_COMMENT,UPDATE_USER,UPDATE_TIME)VALUES(B.FUNCTION_NAME,B.KEY1,B.KEY2,B.KEY3,B.F_COMMENT,B.UPDATE_USER,B.UPDATE_TIME)

SELECT MODULE,EQP_G,WAIT_TIME,HOLD_TIME,HOLD_COUNT,WAIT_COUNT FROM( SELECT MODULE,EQP_G ,ROUND(AVG(WAIT_TIME),1)WAIT_TIME,COUNT(WAIT_TIME)WAIT_COUNT ,ROUND(AVG(HOLD_TIME),1)HOLD_TIME,COUNT(HOLD_TIME)HOLD_COUNT FROM( SELECT MODULE,CASE WHEN (MAINPD_ID LIKE 'DYB%' OR MAINPD_ID LIKE 'B%' OR MAINPD_ID LIKE 'Y%') AND EQP_G IS NULL THEN 'DYB/Branch/Rework' ELSE EQP_G END EQP_G ,CASE WHEN LOT_PROC_STATE = 'Waiting' THEN DUR END WAIT_TIME ,CASE WHEN LOT_PROC_STATE = 'OnHold' THEN DUR END HOLD_TIME FROM A1MFG.PULLIN_LOT_SUMMARY WHERE FUNCTION_NAME=#{functionName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) GROUP BY EQP_G,MODULE )WHERE HOLD_COUNT>0 OR WAIT_COUNT>0 ORDER BY DECODE(MODULE,'PHOTO',1,'ETCH',2,'TF',3,'DIFF',4,'WET',5,'CMP',6,'METRO',7,8),WAIT_TIME DESC,HOLD_TIME DESC,WAIT_COUNT DESC, HOLD_COUNT DESC
